title: Purchase invoice outstanding is converted twice
affected: Accounts Payable Dashboard; Finance internal  controller; Customs & Post-Procurement Dashboard
detail: The three views multiply Purchase Invoice.outstanding_amount by conversion_rate without fetching/checking party_account_currency. The map declares outstanding_amount as Currency with options=party_account_currency, while conversion_rate converts invoice currency to company currency. Live grouping found 105 submitted invoices with positive outstanding whose invoice currency is AED/USD but whose party_account_currency is already SAR (42 AED and 63 USD). Accounts Payable is specifically affected in its invoice-table outstanding renderer; this finding does not imply its report-backed headline KPIs are wrong.
impact: Already-SAR balances are multiplied again; a USD-document balance already stored in SAR is multiplied by rates such as 3.755. Internal Controller AP sums and Customs supplier-payable figures are affected too.
action: Fetch party_account_currency and company default currency. Keep balances unchanged when those currencies match; otherwise use a verified party-currency conversion or native Accounts Payable ledger report. Treasury already demonstrates a party-currency guard.
confidence: Confirmed against map, live effective schema, and live currency-group counts; no financial amounts exported

title: Credit Controller As-of Date does not produce historical outstanding
detail: As-of date only changes due-date buckets. siBase() reads current outstanding_amount and has no posting_date <= asof filter. Past-date selections can therefore include invoices created after the selected date, and invoices paid since that date disappear from historical outstanding.
impact: Past-date receivables and ageing do not represent balances as of that date. The current-date view is a different case and is not proven wrong by this finding.
action: Use native Accounts Receivable/payment-ledger ageing at the selected date, or explicitly restrict the UI to current outstanding with an ageing reference date. A posting-date filter alone does not reconstruct settlements.
evidence: 04. Finance & Credit Control/Credit Controller Dashboard/dashboard.js:67; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Credit Controller Dashboard/dashboard.js:74; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Credit Controller Dashboard/dashboard.js:96

title: Credit Controller sums account-currency amounts without currency grouping
detail: Receivables use sum(outstanding_amount), and collections use sum(paid_amount), without grouping or normalizing their currency basis. The map defines outstanding_amount in party_account_currency and paid_amount in paid_from_account_currency. The note explicitly assumes company currency. Live open Sales Invoice groups are currently SAR/SAR, so mixed-currency receivables are a latent risk rather than an observed current mismatch.
impact: Totals can mix incompatible currencies when companies/customer accounts/payment accounts use different currencies.
action: Choose a company/currency scope; validate currencies, use the matching base payment field, and normalize outstanding via the party account currency.
confidence: Confirmed structural risk; currently open sales-invoice groups are SAR/SAR
evidence: 04. Finance & Credit Control/Credit Controller Dashboard/dashboard.js:42; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Credit Controller Dashboard/dashboard.js:96; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Credit Controller Dashboard/dashboard.js:108

title: Internal Controller duplicate counts stop at 300 groups

title: Closed-period check compares creation to period end, not closure time
detail: Even after the invalid disabled filter is fixed, the exception labelled Posted after accounting period was closed checks creation > end_date 23:59:59, then labels the count confirmed. A period end date does not establish when the period was actually closed. The query also does not prove the submit timestamp.
impact: A legitimate backdated document created before a later closure can be labelled a confirmed posting-after-closure exception.
action: Use an actual closure/submission audit trail if available. Otherwise relabel as an indicative backdated-document check and keep it separate from confirmed control violations.
evidence: 04. Finance & Credit Control/Finance Internal Controller/dashboard.js:806; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Finance Internal Controller/dashboard.js:841; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Finance Internal Controller/dashboard.js:867

title: Vacation tracker omits earlier leaves and assumes unmatched past leaves completed
detail: The initial Leave Application fetch excludes all leaves with to_date before January 1 of the current year, regardless of UI-selected range or whether a linked Employee Vacation Record remains overdue. It also restricts leave to two annual-leave types and durations strictly greater than two days. When no vacation record matches, a past leave becomes Completed without actual return evidence.
impact: Earlier-year overdue cases and short annual leaves cannot appear; missing return tracking can look like a confirmed completion. The type/duration rules may be intentional policy and need business confirmation.
action: Load the selected overlap range plus all still-open vacation records, clearly disclose the annual-leave scope, and mark unmatched past leaves Return unverified until a return record exists.
evidence: 05. HR & Administration/Employee Vacation/dashboard.js:302; 05. HR & Administration/Employee Vacation/dashboard.js:324; 05. HR & Administration/Employee Vacation/dashboard.js:349

title: Blocked Customer cards count customer-salesperson rows as customers
affected: CP Blocked Customer; CSD Blocked Customer; EP Blocked Customer; MP Blocked Customer; SRD Blocked Customer; WP Blocked Customer
detail: All six mapped reports aggregate invoices by customer, join Customer Sales Team, then group detail rows by customer and salesperson. The cards count report rows and sum each row outstanding. If a customer has multiple qualifying salespersons, its full customer-level balance can appear more than once. The queries also hardcode one company, which is a deliberate fixed scope rather than all companies.
impact: Customer counts/blocked percentages and balances can be inflated by one-to-many salesperson assignments. Actual duplicate assignments were not counted in live data.
action: Choose whether the grain is customer or customer-salesperson. For company/customer KPIs, deduplicate on customer ID and compute balances once, or allocate an explicit split.
confidence: Confirmed query structure from map; observed inflation not established
evidence: 04. Finance & Credit Control/Blocked Customer Dashboard/CP Blocked Customer/dashboard.js:55; 04. Finance & Credit Control/Blocked Customer Dashboard/CP Blocked Customer/dashboard.js:58

title: ERP User Access is missing its directory API source in the organized folder
detail: The browser calls /api/method/user_access_directory?..., but its organized server_scripts directory has no user_access_directory script. The complete ignored ERP snapshot does contain the enabled API. The exporter matches quoted method literals ending at a quote, so a URL ending in ? escapes its match.

action: Include that source and teach dependency discovery to parse API URLs, including query strings, rather than relying only on exact quoted text.
